about: Clarissa C. Brady is an attorney who represents clients in the Phoenix, Arizona area. Clarissa Brady is recognized by peers and was selected to Rising Stars for 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Clarissa Brady chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. She attended Suffolk University Law School and graduated in 2020. Clarissa Brady passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 2020.
She represents clients with Bankruptcy: Business issues in Arizona.

Being selected to Rising Stars is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Rising Stars, Clarissa Brady has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
